Subject: NO_TEST
Description: No test should be planned on Monday at any branch or batch.

Subject: CONTIGUOUS
Description: In afternoon/evening batches, there should not be any empty slots between consecutive lectures/tests.

Subject: ANY
Description: Reduce faculty travel: No faculty may visit the same branch twice on any day (e.g. Deepika Madam at Jai Ambe then DAPS then Jai Ambe is forbidden). All lectures at a center must be finished in one visit.

Subject: ANY
Description: Give priority to all faculties who are not backup faculties. Remaining empty slots assigned to backup faculties after primary faculty slots are arranged.

Subject: MATHS
Description: In CBSE evening batches, the lecture of Maths should always be either the first slot or the last slot of the day.

Subject: GUJARATI, HINDI, COMPUTER, ENGLISH
Description: In all evening batches, lectures of Gujarati/Hindi, Computer, and English should always be either the first slot or the last slot.

Subject: GUJARATI, HINDI, COMPUTER, ENGLISH
Description: There should not be Gujarati, English, and Computer lectures on the same day in any evening batch (max 1 auxiliary subject per day).

Subject: ANY
Description: The batch start time for all 6 days (Mon-Sat) for each evening batch must be identical.

Subject: ACCOUNTS
Description: THS Standard 11 first lecture from 7:30 AM to 8:30 AM should always be Accounts (set to YES to activate).

Subject: ACCOUNTS
Description: THS Standard 12 second lecture from 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM should always be Accounts (set to YES to activate).

Subject: ANY
Description: No lecture of any faculty should overlap in 2 different batches.

Subject: ANY
Description: Faculty should have enough time to travel from 1 branch to another branch between 2 lectures.

Subject: ANY
Description: Faculty master data should be followed strictly. No faculty should get less or more number of weekly hours in any batch. Only 10% variation in total weekly hours is acceptable.
